How to Play
Read the word list under the grid.
Hunt for one word at a time.
Words go across, down or diagonally. Never backwards.
Circle each word and cross it off the list.
Take your time and enjoy the holiday cheer!
Stuck? Solutions start on page 58.
Christmas Hunt! is Vol. 5 of the Big Print Word Hunt series.
Enjoyed it? A short review on Amazon helps other puzzle lovers find it.
